tournaments._comment: Every Monday and Thursday night NFL game, whoever's playing. Filtered out of the league-wide scoreboard by kickoff weekday + hour in US Eastern (where 'Monday night' is defined), NOT by broadcast network — the networks move around (the 2026 opener was a Thursday on Netflix) and would miss games. minHour 17 keeps Thanksgiving's afternoon games out while keeping its night game in. A game one of our own teams is playing gets tagged onto that team's card rather than duplicated here.
